Trace parser-rejected requests such as `GET /%% HTTP/1.1` on Akka HTTP 10.2+, where rejection happens before the application handler and otherwise produces no server span. Older supported Akka HTTP versions retain their existing instrumentation without this feature.

The span covers the parsing-error handler, records the actual response status, and preserves sampling and response customization. It uses the current context with normal server-span suppression, without inventing unavailable request attributes or duplicating spans for failures after request delivery.

Fixes #5139.
